name: Country
definition: ISO 3166 country

name: Currency
definition: ISO 4217 currency

name: Incoterm
definition: ICC Incoterms 2020 rule

name: Classification code
definition: Product classification entry

name: Identifier scheme
definition: Registry of identifier schemes (ISO 6523 ICDs and others)
examples: LEI; DUNS; GLN; VAT; EORI; national registry

name: Legal entity
definition: One node per legal person, ours and theirs alike; ours flagged, never a separate model

name: Group
definition: Commercial grouping only (buying group, franchise, global account programme); never legal ownership

name: Relationship
definition: Category anchor per counterparty group per category; anchored in master data, used by the agreement layer

name: Account
definition: Trading arrangement: belongs to one of their entities, held with one of our org units

name: Site
definition: Location with a function: HQ, warehouse, ship-to, consignment location

name: Product
definition: Our SKU with manufacturer, MPN, GTIN, classification

name: Person
definition: Contacts, signatories, e-commerce users

name: Org unit
definition: Our operational structure hanging off our legal entities

name: Identifier
definition: Scheme plus value claim with source and validity; never a single ID field

name: Master-level instrument
definition: Governs a relationship or a project; top of a family tree

name: Participation
definition: Per-entity adoption of a master, signed or deemed

name: Component
definition: Forms part of a parent instrument but changes on its own lifecycle

name: Change
definition: Alters another node: amendment, variation, side letter, change order, pricing letter

name: Work instrument
definition: Scoped engagement under a master
examples: SOW; order form; engagement letter; equipment schedule

name: Shared / by-reference terms
definition: One node referenced by many families; often by URL with capture dates
examples: terms of sale; online MSA; carrier conditions

name: Evidence
definition: Non-contractual record with a validity window
examples: acceptance certificate; DoC; COI; consumption report

name: Security
definition: Secures obligations; own lifecycle; guarantor party edges

name: Clause
definition: Stable-ID unit of a document (eId convention borrowed from Akoma Ntoso)

name: Term fact
definition: Concerto-typed extracted value, bi-temporal

name: Obligation
definition: ODRL-shaped duty, permission or prohibition with obligor and obligee edges

name: Order
definition: PO, call-off, release, blanket, web order

name: Order response
definition: Acknowledgement, confirmation, quote in response

name: Invoice
definition: Billing document

name: Claim
definition: Programme or commercial claim
